content: Regular U-500 insulin is a highly concentrated formulation that necessitates meticulous prescription and monitoring due to its potency. It is exclusively available in prefilled pens or with specialized syringes calibrated specifically for U-500 insulin. In contrast, U-300 and U-200 insulin formulations offer greater flexibility in dosing. These formulations are particularly suitable for individuals with higher insulin requirements and provide the added benefit of prolonged duration of action.
